correctness.rationale: The zero-sum cyclic Green kernel G_ij=(n²-1)/(12n)-d(n-d)/(2n) inverts the cycle Laplacian, and ||x||²=delta^T G delta. Facet labels are exactly balanced +/- words for even cycles, balanced +/- plus one zero for odd cycles. Writing plus-position cyclic gaps as g_i=1+r_i yields a strictly concave weighted pair-separation energy; for nonconsecutive marked sets the capped simplex r_i<=m-1 reduces the minimum to near-vertices (m-1,1,0,...). Direct gap substitution gives even deficit 2(m-1)r(m-r)/m and odd consecutive-zero deficit 2m h(m-h)/(2m+1); endpoint comparisons for missing-gap configurations yield the same sharp odd second shell. Polarity converts next-largest vertex radius to second-nearest supporting facet distance, not continuous interior distances. Independently enumerated all permitted cyclic words n=4..12 using exact fractions and confirmed top and second radii and equality counts. The all-n conclusion follows from strict concavity and gap classification, not the finite enumeration.
